contexts.text: The second temptation of those of the Spiritual Church is described by the murmuring of the people at Marah...
They came to Marah () = a state of temptation.
Therefore he called the name Marah () = the state and quality of that temptation... For Marah means what is bitter.
The waters at Marah, which they could not drink on account of their bitterness, represented adulterated truths; for... bitterness = adulteration...
